author: Spartemex
body:
We are going to have another PlugDJ event friday!

This event will be holiday-themed music only.


Head over to plug.dj/avicus to either sign in to an existing account or create a new one!  Anyone is invited!  It will be starting at 6:30 EST, but the pre-party can start anytime, and no one says when the event will end!
